question: What transformation of the body is claimed after being struck by the veil of ignorance?
premises: The body was struck by ignorance
A present change is declared today
The body is now described as pure
inference: Today my body, once struck by the veil of ignorance, is pure.
uncertainties: deham appears in accusative form but functions as the described subject in this transmitted line.
plain_english: Today my body, once struck by the veil of ignorance, is pure.
